blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea – Pyongyang test-fired two types of cruise missile from a submarine, its state news agency said Thursday, after weeks of friction with Seoul over a landmine explosion along their border. The missiles were fired into the East Sea, also known as the Sea of Japan, on Wednesday without “any adverse impact on the security of neighboring countries”, the official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) said. Relations between Pyongyang and Seoul have been further strained since the landmine blast on September 21 in the Seoul-controlled area of the Demilitarised Zone (DMZ), which injured three South Korean soldiers.
